answer: Replica joiners fail a float they cannot pre-soak. The applicant locks 9.60 POA and, after boom 3 posts its ticket, launches one 1.8-meter timber balk branded with this epoch seed down chute R of the posted river gauge. At the 40-meter staff a clerk pulls a 12-strand dyed thread through two fresh holes and logs three wet-line hashes 70 seconds apart. Peers rebuild those hashes from the public gauge tape and refuse a second balk on chute R. Cost: 9.60 POA plus one live float. A pre-soaked balk, a reused dye, or a skipped interval forfeits 54% and seals chute R for four epochs.
